description: Boss groups with num>0 appear exactly at levels 10,20,...; map1 has 10 gates (10-100), map10/map2 have 6 (10-60).
Configured kill threshold is 40 but only 15 monsters are spawned; GameLevelConfig clamps the effective threshold to 15.
Configured threshold 75 vs 61 spawned; effective threshold 61.
Configured threshold 69 vs 61 spawned; effective threshold 61.
Level 20 spawns one boss (3021) and has kills=1; adjacent levels have 55-75 kills.
Level 98 has more effective HP (940,572) than the final level 100 boss gate (312,800).
Under the single-run weapon-only spend model, these levels have DPS/required ratios below 1; minimum 0.771 at level 96. Weapon 28 cumulative cost 5,109,500 exceeds gold available before these levels.
Single-run weapon-only model has shortfalls at these levels; minimum 0.775 at level 51. Level 56 (0.888) is the last level before weapon 28 becomes affordable; level 57 jumps to 1.223 with weapon 28.
Staging map 2 has similar single-run affordability shortfalls; minimum 0.812 at level 53. Final level is 1.305 after weapon 28 is affordable.
Hard map weapon 28 is a 6-pellet shotgun (map1 is a 1-pellet rifle), producing a large DPS jump.
Staging map 2 uses a 3-pellet version of the same weapon-28 family.
With all weapons considered unlocked and the cumulative-exp player level, final-level DPS is 11,549 vs 11,608 required (0.995); required player level is 687.9 vs actual 678.
Staging map 2 final margin is 1.305; required player level 228.5 vs actual 680.
Staging map 2 final basement is 3,700,000 HP vs 138,750 on hard map 10 (26.67x).
Boss 3031 has 99,999 base attack vs 1,200 for boss 3021; scaled by 3.7 at monster level 900.
PlayerLevelConfig has 30 rows; levels above 30 use defaultUpgradeExp=1000 per level; maxLv is 1000.
Weapons stop at level 30; equipment armor stops at 100, boots at 20.
No row-level table changes were detected within any map/channel across all 41 downloaded versions; changes are map availability and packaging only.
Hard map 10 first appears in v10110 and its tables/config are identical through v10113.
Staging map 2 appears only in v10113 (maps-staging).
Every equipment part has a large price spike at level 1 then every 5 levels; tier item IDs change at 25/50/75 (armor) and 5/10/15 (boots).
Weapon max cost 6,403,500 + equipment max cost 3,046,160 = 9,449,660; a full map1 clear yields 3,405,820 gold.
